row.title: MERGE-NOW-1: PRs merge on the webhook, not on a clock
row.body: Rowan 2026-11-21: no PR sits in GitHub. Root causes: the Actions lane wakes only when checks finish, so a conflicting PR waited for the 10-minute tick or the daily sweep; the tick sweeper refreshed only 'behind' PRs and left 'dirty' ones; workflow-touching conflicting PRs had no owner that could merge them; site/dashboard-data.js carried HEAD's sha so every merge changed it; README claim counts churned on every deploy; merges left conflict markers in README.md and platform/adapters/README.md. Change: seed/worker/src/mergenow.js runs inside the /hook/github request on pull_request, check_suite (now subscribed) and push to main with the org App token: ready, approve waiting runs, update-branch, reconcile conflicts on generated files (seed/worker/src/generated.js equals regen_generated OUTPUTS, tested) and claim values through the git data API then POST /merges, squash-merge on green at the exact head. The sweeper reconciles one dirty PR per tick and records merge_p50/p95, oldest open PR and stalled PRs (migration 0029, self-applied DDL); a PR open over 15 minutes files Q-PR-STALL-*. build_dashboard asof is the last commit of its sources; resolve_generated takes identical and claim-only hunks in any file. 410 Worker tests pass.

title: MERGE-NOW-1: PRs merge on the webhook, not on a clock
